Subject: SCIM delta + RBAC snapshot for SIG assessment

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. As part of our SIG questionnaire follow-up, the security team asked for a few specific artifacts to validate provisioning and least-privilege controls:

- SCIM delta export (last 60–90 days) with timestamps and operation types (create/update/delete)
